messages:
maria: Quick heads up — RC build for 2024-03 is green except for a hotfix that needs approvals before today's cutoff at 18:00 PST. PR #5281 touches token cache invalidation and must land in this cycle.

alex_h: On it, can review tonight. Is infra approval required? :thinking: 

maria: Yes — we need two engineer approvals plus one infra (perf/regression) sign-off before merge. Also adds a small config change (see diff).

jamie: I'll take a pass now. If it's small I can approve. Ping me if CI flakes.

rik: I'm in infra rotation today, will review perf numbers and KV cache impact. ETA 45m.

ci-bot: Build passed (linux, macos), integration tests running — 12m remaining. :white_check_mark: 

alex_h: quick note — the cherry-pick I used locally to recreate the issue:
```
git checkout -b hotfix/5281 upstream/main
git cherry-pick 4f9a7b1
```
Works for me but want infra sanity.

jamie: left 2 tiny comments on the PR (nit + edge-case). If those look fine to you @maria, I can approve.

maria: comments addressed. @rik once you give infra ack, can someone trigger the merge? Cutoff 18:00 PST — if we miss it we'll have to wait for the next window.

rik: infra ack — perf delta <1% on our benchmark. :thumbsup: Go ahead.

alex_h: merging now. deploy-bot will post status.

deploy-bot: Merge triggered for PR #5281 by alex_h. Post-merge CI queued.

maria: thanks everyone — appreciate the quick turnaround. :pray:
